title: CODATA 2022: the Rydberg constant is 10 973 731.568 157 per metre
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 012 m⁻¹. The same listing gives Rydberg times hc as 13.605 693 122 990 eV.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'Rydberg constant 10 973 731.568 157' with standard uncertainty '0.000 012', unit m⁻¹. It prints 'Rydberg constant times hc in eV 13.605 693 122 990' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 015' eV. That electron-volt figure is the listing's value for the Rydberg energy, not a rounded '13.6 eV' offered as exact.
